# Mara Voss

<!-- bm:media id=hero kind=image preset=hero focal={"x":0.5,"y":0.3} caption=true -->
![A wide-angle shot of the Dolomites at dawn](images/dolomites.svg)

<!-- bm:block id=opening preset=lead label="Opening statement" -->
Capturing the quiet dialogue between light and stone.
Based in the high altitudes of the Alps, Mara Voss documents the fleeting moments where
geology meets atmosphere.
<!-- bm:/block -->

## The Philosophy
Mara's work is defined by a patient observation of the "in-between" moments—the mist
settling over a valley, the first crack of ice on a lake, and the way shadows stretch
across a jagged ridge. Each photograph is a deliberate attempt to freeze a feeling
rather than just a scene.

<!-- bm:var name=focus scope=section value=macro -->

# The Alpine Series

The Dolomites provide a rugged, textured playground for exploring the interplay of
scale and detail. From the towering peaks to the smallest lichen-covered rock,
the series explores the architecture of the wild.

<!-- bm:columns id=landscape-split count=2 weights=[2,1] label="Scale and Detail" -->
<!-- bm:col id=landscape-story label="The Grand Scale" -->
## The Architecture of Stone
The mountains are not just objects; they are stories written in limestone and granite.
By focusing on the massive silhouettes of the peaks, Mara highlights the enduring
strength of the earth against the ephemeral nature of the weather.

![The Dolomites at dawn](images/dolomites.svg)

<!-- bm:col id=landscape-detail preset=card label="The Small Details" -->
## Texture & Light
| Element | Characteristic |
|---|---|
| Texture | Rough, jagged, porous |
| Light | Diffused, golden hour |
| Mood | Solitary, expansive |

**Note:** The smallest details often tell the biggest stories.
